note: Small owner-run RV park in Mount Carmel (224 Golden Aces Way), near the local airport and golf course and Beall Woods State Park. There are no restrooms or showers, so a rig must be self-contained; nightly guests share it with monthly tenants. Inland lot, no water frontage. --Claude
